scripts.lint: pnpm -r --if-present lint && uv run ruff check .
scripts.test: pnpm -r --if-present test && uv run pytest -q && pnpm test:db
scripts.test:db: supabase test db && pnpm --filter @margoai/web test:int && MARGO_DB_TESTS=1 uv run pytest -q packages/contracts && supabase gen types typescript --local 2>/dev/null | diff -q - packages/contracts/src/database.types.ts
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && uv run python scripts/check_screens.py && uv run python scripts/secret_scan.py
